exposure: multiple cesarean sections (2 or 3 prior cesareans)
cohort: 100 women with multiple prior cesarean sections (80 with 2 and 20 with 3) at a tertiary care hospital in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, India.
finding: Increased maternal morbidity, including bladder/bowel adhesions, morbidly adherent placenta, and scar dehiscence, were significantly higher in women with three prior cesarean sections compared to those with two.
